skills.name: script-analysis
skills.description: Extract structure, beats, characters, locations, and production flags from a script.

skills.name: narrative-structure
skills.description: Evaluate and shape act structure, arcs, stakes, and pacing.

skills.name: character-consistency
skills.description: Define and enforce identity anchors so a character reads the same in every asset.

skills.name: character-sheet-generation
skills.description: Produce multi-angle character reference sheets suitable as generation references.

skills.name: location-design
skills.description: Design locations with geography, lighting logic, and reusable reference angles.

skills.name: location-mapping
skills.description: Build spatial maps of locations: zones, camera angles, entrances, and sightlines.

skills.name: visual-style-development
skills.description: Develop a coherent visual language: palette, texture, lensing, and grade intent.

skills.name: scene-blocking
skills.description: Stage characters and action in space, establishing axes and movement paths.

skills.name: cinematography
skills.description: Choose shot sizes, lenses, camera moves, and lighting per scene intent.

skills.name: shot-sequencing
skills.description: Order shots into coverage that cuts: rhythm, axis discipline, and clip boundaries.

skills.name: storyboard-generation
skills.description: Turn shots into storyboard frames with composition and staging annotations.

skills.name: reference-selection
skills.description: Pick the reference images a generation must use, within provider slot limits.

skills.name: prompt-compilation
skills.description: Compile bibles, shots, and references into provider-ready prompt packages.

skills.name: image-generation
skills.description: Run image providers well: parameters, reference wiring, retries, and QC.

skills.name: video-generation
skills.description: Run video providers well: duration limits, frame conditioning, motion prompts, QC.

skills.name: continuity-checking
skills.description: Audit axes, screen direction, wardrobe, and prop state across shots and scenes.

skills.name: edit-planning
skills.description: Plan the edit: selects, order, transitions, sound, and timeline documentation.

skills.name: production-orchestration
skills.description: Sequence pipeline phases, route work to agents, and enforce approval gates.
